name: Weekly newsletter first draft
description: Collect the week's published work and team updates, then draft the newsletter for an editor to finish.

name: Add new AI models to the database
description: Read new papers and pull out model details (size, training compute, dataset) into the team's database for a researcher to check.

name: Meeting notes to action items
description: Turn meeting notes into a list of action items with owners and due dates.

name: Sort expense receipts
description: Read receipts, fill in amount, date and category, and file them for the monthly expense report.

name: Social posts for new reports
description: Draft short social media posts whenever a new report is published.

name: Answer repeated AI tool questions
description: A bot that answers common 'how do I...' questions about the team's AI tools before a person steps in.

name: Sort press and partner emails
description: Read the shared inbox, label press, partner and other requests, and suggest who should reply.

name: Monthly benchmark results summary
description: Summarize new AI benchmark results each month for the team. Nobody has had time to do this so far.

name: Weekly AI company news check
description: Check news about AI companies each week and flag updates (funding, staff, revenue) for the companies database.

name: Shared prompt for paper summaries
description: One tested prompt that everyone uses to summarize a paper in the team's standard format.

name: New papers posted to team chat
description: Running: posts new papers on chosen topics to the team chat each morning.

name: Website broken-link checker
description: Running: checks the website for broken links once a month. Keeps breaking when the site changes.

name: Monthly AI tool spend report
description: Running: pulls billing from each AI tool account and builds one monthly spend report.
